_readme: Data for the Idea Spaghetti game (Ch2). `targets` are the numbers on the ingredients on the book's board, read from the artwork (source/artwork/SPAGHETTI GAME A:W.ai) on 2026-11-07: a fork's prong leads through the tangle to an ingredient, and its number is how many ideas you need in five minutes. Sixteen ingredients, with 19 twice. Here a target is dealt at random instead of by following a strand. `topics` are the book's list of 'Topics for ideas' (page 35 to 36) in US spelling; 'have more sex' is left out for a workplace site. Mark reviews.
topics: Reality TV shows that ought to be made
Things they should teach in school but don't
